skill_name: Describe how wireless networks send and receive information.
workflow: Wireless networks use radio waves to send and receive information between two or more devices. When a device sends a signal, the radio waves are transmitted to a nearby receiver, which can then decode and interpret the data. Wireless networks rely on access points to act as the intermediary between the sender and receiver.
